reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Fix AWS Route53 error detection for not-found errors during deletion of DNS records", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: When cert-manager deletes DNS records in AWS Route53, it now correctly detects not-found errors. This is a bug fix and needs no operator action.

proposed.statement: cert-manager 1.18.0 fixes how the AWS Route53 DNS01 solver detects not-found errors when it deletes DNS records.
